name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in complex scenes—like excavation edges—without distorting depth, which most upscalers botch. The trade-off is higher VRAM usage, but EXCAVA’s hardware already handles it. RealVisXL’s face-preserving upscaler comes next, but depth-first fixes the biggest visual bottleneck now.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—faces blur worse under depth shifts, and InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth model isn’t trained on forensic-grade excavation imagery. Instead, test RealVisXL’s face-preserving upscaler *only* on the face region after depth-aware upscaling, but cap style drift by freezing the face encoder weights—if the face encoder’s loss spikes >0.3% on a 100-image validation set, scrap it.
